questions.question:
What does the following Django view code do?
from django.shortcuts import render
from models import Book
def latest_books(request):
book_list = Book.objects.order_by('-pub_date')[:10]
return render(request, 'latest_books.html', {'book_list':
book_list})

options.text: Retrieves latest 10 books and renders them using a template
